chunks.subject: AP Statistics
chunks.title: Q5 — Multi-Focus (4 points)
chunks.content: AP Statistics FRQ 5 is Multi-Focus, 4 points, combining skills from multiple content areas (e.g., data analysis, probability, and inference in one scenario). Each lettered part is scored E/P/I and combined into an integer 0–4. Typical tasks span reading/interpreting data or a model, a probability or expected-value computation, and a short inference or interpretation. Common failure: mishandling one of the linked skills (e.g., correct data reading but a flawed probability or inference step); interpretations without context; computations without setup.

chunks.subject: AP Statistics
chunks.title: Q5 exemplar — Sample 5A, 4/4
chunks.content: Q5 scored 4/4 — all parts essentially correct across the multiple content areas, with correct computations (setup shown) and contextual interpretations. Full-credit model for the multi-focus question.

chunks.subject: AP Statistics
chunks.title: Q5 exemplar — Sample 5B, 3/4
chunks.content: Q5 scored 3/4 — most parts correct with one partial, commonly one of the linked skills (a probability or inference step) incomplete or lacking context. Illustrates a strong multi-focus response one part short.

chunks.subject: AP Statistics
chunks.title: Q5 exemplar — Sample 5C, 2/4
chunks.content: Q5 scored 2/4 — some parts partial: handled one content area but mishandled another (e.g., correct data reading but flawed probability/inference), or omitted context/setup. Illustrates uneven command across the linked skills.
